item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00040","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C07","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.72,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for C04’s later public-mobilization proclamation. C07 and C05 share proclamation form but lack comparable operative outreach or substantive structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"such a program calls for the combined efforts of the public and of all agencies, both public and private, concerned with the problem","parent_excerpt":"many important agencies, governmental and private, national and local, and individuals the country over, banded together","explanation":"Both recitals frame successful control as requiring coordinated public, private, institutional, and individual participation."},{"child_excerpt":"I also invite the medical profession, the press, the radio, the motion-picture industry, and all organizations and individuals interested... to unite during the month of April in a concerted effort","parent_excerpt":"do hereby call upon the people of the United States, in their homes and churches, in the schools and hospitals, in social welfare and health agencies, in enforcement agencies and courts... to act, individually and together... during the month of April 1948","explanation":"The operative provisions use parallel enumerations of social and professional institutions followed by a call for collective action during April 1948."},{"child_excerpt":"a national program for the control of cancer by education and other cooperative means","parent_excerpt":"to develop firm foundations for continuing community action; and to take such other action as may be useful in solving this vital youth problem","explanation":"Both proclamations translate a national control objective into educational or community-based cooperative action rather than direct federal administration."}]}
